name: Image Gen
description: Generate images using ComfyUI or other local image APIs.
doc:
Generate AI images from text prompts.

Supported APIs:
• ComfyUI (Stable Diffusion, FLUX, etc.)
• Any OpenAI-compatible image API (set the endpoint per node)

Features:
• Custom dimensions (width/height)
• Negative prompts to avoid unwanted elements
• Image-to-image with input images
• Input image size limits for API compatibility

Tip: Set default API settings in Project Settings to avoid configuring each node.

inputs.name: Image
inputs.description: A picture to start from (img2img, or an edit's reference), or a list of them (OAIY's engine: FLUX 3 Klein takes up to 10)

outputs.name: Image
outputs.description: The picture made: its file's URL where OAIY's engine made it, else its bytes (a data URL)

outputs.name: Info
outputs.description: What OAIY's engine said of the picture: its file's URL, the model, seed and each stage's time (null elsewhere)

properties.name: Service Preset
properties.description: Pick a registered image-gen service (manage in Settings → Services) to auto-fill endpoint + model. Fields below still override the preset. Leave blank to use the inline endpoint / API Format below.

properties.name: API Key Constant
properties.description: Name of the constant containing API key

properties.name: API Format
properties.description: Image backend. 'ComfyUI' for local workflows, or 'External (OpenAI-compatible)' for any generic HTTP image API — set the Endpoint + API Key below. The tool-specific Wan2GP and Gemini formats were removed; re-add { "value": "wan2gp" } / { "value": "gemini" } here if you need them.

properties.name: Negative Prompt
properties.description: What to avoid in the image

properties.name: Same shape as the first picture
properties.description: Make the picture the shape of the first picture given it (at about a megapixel) instead of Width x Height: for edits

properties.name: Seed
properties.description: The same seed, prompt and size make the same picture again; empty: a new one each run (OAIY's engine)

properties.name: Free the picture model after this step
properties.description: Let the picture model go as soon as this picture is made, not kept for the next: for a flow's last picture, before a step that needs another model (OAIY's engine)

properties.name: Image Inputs
properties.description: Number of image inputs for img2img

properties.name: Max Input Image Dimension
properties.description: Maximum width/height for input images (0 = use default 1024px). Only applies when image inputs are connected.

properties.name: Max Input Image Size (KB)
properties.description: Maximum input image size in KB (0 = use default 200KB). Only applies when image inputs are connected.
